mapper.sql: id, msg_id, tx_no, born_topic, born_group, watch_group, tag, msg_key, body, reconsume_times, born_time, dlq_time, status, resend_count, last_resend_time, operate_account, operate_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_dlq_log (msg_id, tx_no, born_topic, born_group, watch_group, tag, msg_key, body, reconsume_times, born_time, dlq_time, status, resend_count, create_time) VALUES (#{msgId}, #{txNo}, #{bornTopic}, #{bornGroup}, #{watchGroup}, #{tag}, #{msgKey}, #{body}, #{reconsumeTimes}, #{bornTime}, #{dlqTime}, #{status}, #{resendCount}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_dlq_log SET status = 1, resend_count = resend_count + 1, last_resend_time = NOW(), operate_account = #{operateAccount}, operate_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mq_dlq_log SET status = #{status}, operate_account = #{operateAccount}, operate_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE mq_dlq_log SET status = 0, resend_count = 0, operate_account = #{operateAccount}, operate_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
